body: In 341 of 13,511 latin songs (2.5%), mostly in song and verse sections; mostly in minor keys: use the project's key in minor, or its relative major if that's what the project is in, and read the numerals there.

A loop of 4 chords, written from the tonic when it's in it (songs start it anywhere). Numerals follow the key's own scale (natural minor in minor keys); b and # mark roots outside it. A bar per chord; change the rhythm and voicing to suit the part.
From user-written chord charts, with each song's key estimated: frequent progressions are reliable, rarer ones less so.
